method: Decode exact gzipped Lighthouse Trace events; profile identity uses pid/id, and the Profile start event identifies the renderer thread. Sum per-sample timeDeltas for leaf self and inclusive ancestor stacks; intersect sample intervals with original main-thread RunTask intervals. Sampling approximates stack time, not exact native CPU work. Original X-event and FunctionCall durations remain separately labeled; simulated LHR values are not mixed with trace time. WebKit RAF requestId pairs and timer heartbeat samples establish actual pending wait and event-loop responsiveness.
limitations: Trace/profile instrumentation affects timings; diagnostic completion does not accept performance.

Research uses identical normal Color bytes on loopback and a different runner from failed hosted staging; old 102.142/153.478ms late task stacks were not retained. Current hotspots are not proof of the exact function in those historical outliers.
WebKit native rendering/presentation delay is localized independently of hold, lost RAF and other browser engines; browser-native component or driver is not identified by JavaScript traces.
Two trials per WebKit load condition are a bounded cause screen, not a population estimate.
